description_en: Retrieves a list of start and stop operation records for real-time tasks. Available since version 6.4.0
description_zh: 获取实时任务启停操作记录列表，上线版本：v6.4.0
name: ListStreamOpsRecords

parameters.help_en: The ID of the operator user
parameters.name: op_user_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Dataphin project to which the task belongs. This parameter is used for permission verification in the production environment
parameters.help_zh: 任务所属的Dataphin项目ID，用于生产环境权限校验
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task file. Set this parameter to the fileId value returned by the GetStreamTask operation. The value must be a positive integer. Do not set this parameter to nodeId or taskId
parameters.help_zh: 任务文件ID，取GetStreamTask返回的fileId，需为正整数格式；不是nodeId或taskId
parameters.name: file_id

Data.description_en: The start and stop operation records for real-time tasks. You can use the log storage identifiers in the list to query the log content by calling the GetStreamOpsRecord operation
Data.description_zh: 实时任务的启停操作记录；列表中的日志存储标识可通过 GetStreamOpsRecord 查询为日志正文

items.description_en: The start and stop operation records for real-time tasks. You can use the log storage identifiers in the list to query the log content by calling the GetStreamOpsRecord operation
items.description_zh: 实时任务的启停操作记录；列表中的日志存储标识可通过 GetStreamOpsRecord 查询为日志正文

DeploymentId.description_en: The deployment ID of the task. This ID is used to identify the deployment and is different from the specific running instance ID deploymentInstanceId
DeploymentId.description_zh: 任务的部署ID，用于标识部署，与具体运行实例ID deploymentInstanceId 不同

DeploymentInstanceId.description_en: The deployment instance ID associated with this operation. This ID corresponds to the DeploymentInstanceId request parameter in the log and TaskManager query operations
DeploymentInstanceId.description_zh: 本次操作关联的部署运行实例ID，对应日志和TaskManager查询接口的 DeploymentInstanceId 入参
DeploymentInstanceId.title_en: 本次操作关联的部署运行实例ID
DeploymentInstanceId.title_zh: 本次操作关联的部署运行实例ID

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the operation. The time is in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. If the operation has not ended, the value may be null
EndTime.description_zh: 操作结束时间，格式 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss；尚无结束时间时可能为null

LogContent.description_en: The operation logs. In the ListStreamOpsRecords response, this field may contain a log storage identity. After you invoke the GetStreamOpsRecord operation, the log content or operation information is returned
LogContent.description_zh: 操作日志。ListStreamOpsRecords 中可能为日志存储标识，调用 GetStreamOpsRecord 后返回日志正文或操作信息

Operate.description_en: The type of the operation. Valid values: START, PAUSE, RESUME, and STOP. This field does not represent the running status of the task
Operate.description_zh: 操作类型：START启动、PAUSE暂停、RESUME恢复、STOP停止；不是任务运行状态

OpsRecordId.description_en: The ID of the operation record. This ID corresponds to the OpsRecordId request parameter of the GetStreamOpsRecord operation
OpsRecordId.description_zh: 操作记录ID，对应 GetStreamOpsRecord 的 OpsRecordId 入参

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the operation. The time is in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
StartTime.description_zh: 操作开始时间，格式 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

items.title_en: 获取实时任务启停操作记录列表
items.title_zh: 获取实时任务启停操作记录列表

Data.title_en: 获取实时任务启停操作记录列表
Data.title_zh: 获取实时任务启停操作记录列表

Message.description_en: The details of the backend response exception

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
